substeps.label: 1/3 The week
substeps.caption: Maintenance in the workflow. A lab that runs round the clock still needs looking after: balances checked, bowls cleaned, filters changed, thermocouples verified. Each task is booked like a job, with who does it: the arm between jobs, or a person on a weekday shift.
